raw_occurrence_identity.raw_full_body:
THAT Council renew TUP20-0003 to allow for a computer programing training and
      educational facility for children at 890 Goldstream Avenue for a period of three years
      subject to the following conditions:

          a.   That the Temporary Use Permit be issued only to Jesse Bowness, doing business
               as Code Ninjas Westshore and not be transferred to any subsequent business or
               business owner should Code Ninja Westshore cease to operate.
